summary: Defines the edge types, SymbolEdge/Edge interfaces, and IndexedFile structure that all traversal and indexing logic builds on. SymbolEdge carries from/to (qualified symbolId or fileId), type (calls/extends/implements/exports), and optional line number. IndexedFile holds symbols, exports, isBarrel flag, reexportRatio, and importedByCount—these are load-bearing for cycle guards and barrier detection in graph traversal.
